name: What is an attached home addition?

mainEntity.name: What is an attached home addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: An attached home addition is a new structure physically connected to an existing house, expanding its square footage. This can include adding new rooms like bedrooms, bathrooms, family rooms, or even a second story. Unlike detached structures, attached additions share walls and often utilities with the original home, creating a seamless transition and integrated living space. They are a common way to increase living area and property value without moving.
acceptedAnswer.description: An attached home addition is a new structure physically connected to an existing house, expanding its square footage and integrating with its design.
